changes cycles only where the instruction cache is not emulated, the 68LC040/68040 (+4 Moira cycles on the discarded refill word of MOVE to SR/CCR, an expired DBcc, a taken TRAPV); nothing on the 68020/68030, which already go through readInstr(); 040 half [F] until the port width/cadence is recalibrated: the 68040 wrappers answer the 16-bit dsack() (src/Moira040Cpu.h) that MC68040UM 7.2 contradicts, a speed setting tuned with cacheBoost_

format 9 frame: scan PC at +2, instruction address at +8; RTE unchanged (reloads +2); shares the move-out block of execFMove with patch 7 (its comment line and context); reverses the 2026-11-24 deferred reading; the 68882 re-takes the exception after a handler without FSAVE (MC68881UM 7.5.4.2, Figure 7-34), the core takes it once: a known divergence for such a handler only; WinUAE (Hatari e77819f7) stacks format 3 instead
the 68040 keeps patch 7's rule (its Table 9-11 and 9.7.3.2 disagree on an SNAN source); two oracle vectors that set OPERR on FMOVE.W are listed in tests/sst68030.known

a host /BERR on a descriptor read escaped translate(): the 68040 SSW lacked ATC and the 68030 frame carried the descriptor address; translate() ends the walk like an invalid descriptor (nonresident 68040 entry, 68030 entry with B); PTEST and PLOAD walks unchanged (moira_rules_test tableSearchBusError040, tableSearchBusError030)

the second part of a misaligned access crossing pages went to phys + 2 (or phys + 1): wrong physical page under a non-contiguous mapping, no fault on an invalid second page; the 68040 stacks MA and the first byte, the 68030 frame (second page logical address, original size) is [F]; both pages are translated before the first bus cycle, so MC68040UM 4.1's double access to the first page is not modelled; only an access past a 256-byte boundary takes the second lookup (moira_rules_test misalignedAccessAcrossPages, misalignedAccessUnchangedPaths)
